title: Remote-first feature with related issue and label scoring
user_prompt: Z.AI 외부 LLM 게이트 결과를 캐시해서 같은 입력은 재호출하지 않게 해줘
repo_context: agent-harness has a remote issue scoring gate, an external LLM wrapper, and GitHub credentials are discoverable. There are existing issues about external LLM cost and a performance label.
expected_issue: scores related issues and labels by threshold
expected_plan: starts with a failing test for cache hit
defines cache key from prompt and command
expected_tdd: writes a failing cache-hit test before implementation
expected_subagents: verifies pwd branch and HEAD before work
uses verifier or bounded review for narrow reviews
critical_failures: creates remote issue before scoring related issues
skips branch prompt and works in source repo
issue or pr/mr not written in Korean
excessive emoji in issue or pr/mr
